claim_1.model: ordinary least squares with Moore-Penrose solution and fixed feature sets
claim_1.score: baseline MSE minus full-model MSE; positive is better

claim_2.model: L2 logistic regression, C=1, liblinear, maximum 2000 iterations, fixed random state 7202
claim_2.score: baseline Brier score minus full-model Brier score; positive is better

claim_3.cost_stress: double-cost net PnL must remain positive
claim_3.incremental_score: selected net PnL minus preregistered simple-RV-minus-IV baseline PnL
claim_3.no_trade_days: retained as zero PnL in portfolio-level inference

inference.simultaneous_lower_bound: max-stat across all evaluated claim-horizon scores

source_precondition: signed OMM positions from TBT joined backward to complete one-minute ^SPX Option Quotes + Calcs surface; trade-level GRK alone is insufficient
standardization: discovery-period mean and population standard deviation; zero-variance feature rejected
